trials.claim: Previous customers can upgrade license to increase feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased Wideo can upgrade their license to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to confirm or contradict that previous customers can upgrade.

trials.claim: Includes all future Basic, Pro, or Pro+ plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Basic (Tier 1), Pro (Tier 2), or Pro+ (Tier 3-5) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms limit lifetime access to as long as Wideo continues providing the services and allow Wideo to change the terms at its sole discretion, materially limiting the promise of all future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: Once you have made your purchase of the Lifetime Plan, it will last until whichever is earlier: (i) for life; (ii) as long as we continue to provide the Services on the Site;
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access ends when vendor stops providing services, so future plan updates are not guaranteed.

exhibits.quote: Wideo reserves the right in its sole discretion to, change, modify, add, or remove portions of these Terms and Conditions
exhibits.argument: Vendor can unilaterally change terms, undermining promise of all future updates.

trials.claim: Produces branded video content in minutes with AI scripts, voiceovers, translation and templates
trials.claimQuote: Produce branded video content in minutes with AI scripts, voiceovers, translation, and 300+ templates
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms videos can be finished in 5 minutes from a template and scripts can be turned into AI voiceovers. The single partial blog-to-video test and the note about AI Avatars do not materially undercut those capabilities.

exhibits.quote: During my retest, the blog to video tool only captured part of the article I tested.
exhibits.argument: AI script/video generation failed to fully convert source content.

exhibits.quote: The team clarified that AI Avatars are a custom solution, not a regular
exhibits.argument: AI Avatars are not included as a regular feature despite AI content claims.

exhibits.quote: With Wideo, you can choose a template and finish your video in 5 minutes — no experience necessary.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms branded video content can be finished in 5 minutes from a template.

exhibits.quote: Transform your written scripts into a realistic AI voiceover

trials.claim: Offers 300+ fully customizable business templates for marketing, social, sales and more
trials.claimQuote: Choose from 300+ fully customizable business templates spanning marketing, social, sales, and more
trials.reasoning: The exhibits say Wideo offers 'hundreds' of templates for marketing, social media and more, but they do not establish the specific 300+ count or that they are fully customizable business templates.

exhibits.quote: Wideo offers hundreds to ensure you find exactly what you need.
exhibits.argument: Vendor claims only hundreds of templates, not 300+ fully customizable business templates.

exhibits.quote: Wideo offers hundreds to ensure you find exactly what you need.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms offering hundreds of templates to choose from.

exhibits.quote: Wideo uses templates to help you create professional videos for marketing, internal communications, social media and more.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms templates cover marketing, social and more business uses.

trials.claim: Drag and drop editing without touching a timeline
trials.claimQuote: Drag and drop text, images, and brand colors into any scene without touching a timeline
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms a drag-and-drop editing workflow for graphics. The review about learning tweening concerns ease of use, not the existence of drag-and-drop editing.

exhibits.quote: I wouldn't say it is totally easy unless u use only template. The tweening may need a little learning.
exhibits.argument: Editing requires learning tweening, contradicting no-timeline drag-and-drop ease.

exhibits.quote: Drag-and-drop graphics or choose from thousands of stock footage from our FREE video library.

trials.claim: Allows upgrading between 5 license tiers while deal is available
trials.claimQuote: Ability to upgrade between 5 license tiers while the deal is available
trials.reasoning: The terms exhibit only says payments for one service cannot be credited to other services, using a download versus subscription example; it does not address upgrading between license tiers of the same deal, and no exhibit confirms the upgrade ability.

exhibits.quote: Payments made for a Service cannot be credited to other Services (for example, the payment made for a download may not be applied as part of the payment of a one-year Subscription Plan).
exhibits.argument: Payments cannot be credited to other services, blocking upgrades between tiers.
